description: Points the shop's Aopy tracking subdomain (passed in the host parameter, for example aopy for aopy.shop.ro) at Aopy's merchant edge on CloudFront. The CNAME must stay DNS only (not proxied).
variableDescription: %edge%: the first label of Aopy's CloudFront routing endpoint for this environment (<edge>.cloudfront.net), set by Aopy from its own configuration, never by the user.
